title: A positivity preserving and entropy stable nodal discontinuous Galerkin scheme for ideal MHD
summary: Numerically solving magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) equations faces many challenges: avoiding divergence error, maintaining positivity, and satisfying entropy conditions. Among discontinuous Galerkin (DG) schemes, there has been a modal version that is locally divergence-free and positivity preserving and a nodal version that is semi-discretely entropy stable. In this work, we develop a DG scheme that combines the advantages of these two and solves all the three challenges.
